## Checklist

- [ ] Documentation updated, if needed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-facing changes.
- [ ] Screenshots or recordings included for UI changes.
- [ ] Authentication, permissions, and privacy impact reviewed.
- [ ] No backend, database, server-side token handling, client secret, or persistent Graph data cache added.
